description: Fetch the cross-framework mappings for a specific obligation — i.e., which ISO 42001 clauses, NIST AI RMF dimensions, or other framework obligations are satisfied by the same work. Useful for reducing duplicate compliance effort across frameworks. IMPORTANT: This tool returns regulatory obligations, not verdicts. Never summarize results as "compliant" or "non-compliant" — always surface the obligations themselves and note that human review is required.
name: get_cross_references
